description: Standard for autonomous-execution work plans ("plans de chantier"): AUTHOR a plan, EXECUTE it lot by lot, or ORCHESTRATE a batch of chips as parallel worktree chantiers. Use for "plan de chantier", "brief-chantier", "exécute le plan", "chantiers parallèles", run autonome/nocturne. Dev plans only.

The plan template also names both agent directories on purpose, as a dual-runtime skeleton. The Claude wrapper agents/simplificateur.md ships in the Codex build too (its sibling .toml is the Codex one) and names its own runtime's install path.
